title: in direct mode the first prompt passed to claude carries the ROUTE-SCOPE: line of the build
source: intended: PLAN.md defect S1 (the first prompt is what the router can read in time); the TS prompt is only 'Read <brief> and follow it exactly.'
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect S1, route_scope). The router reads a scope with the regex (?:^|[.!?])[ \t>*-]*ROUTE-SCOPE:([^\n]*), so the card line must start with ROUTE-SCOPE: (with the colon, at a line start or after . ! ?) and list the build ids comma separated.
